messages:
customer-support: FYI a customer on eu-west reported token-costs showing $0 and some NaN values in the dashboard this morning. Happened after last night's rollup.

sam: Can you paste org id and a screenshot? any CSV export attached?

customer-support: Org: org_8fa2, attached CSV (small sample). UI tiles show $0, hourly rows show NaN for total_cost.

kim: grabbing logs for the pricing lookup flow. Do these orgs have any reserved capacity/enterprise pricing?

customer-support: org_8fa2 is a standard paid org (no reserved). Another affected reported by the customer: org_3b7c (also standard).

maria: quick grep of last night's rollup job (metric_compaction) shows a warning for those partitions: "pricing_lookup returned null for 2 orgs, skipping price join" — looks like join mismatch error. attaching log excerpt.

alex: is this the same join mismatch we saw last month with legacy-subaccount ids?

maria: Possibly related but different clue: the pricing table refresh job failed to update FX rates for eu-west for a 15min window at 02:13 UTC. If price is null and we multiply usage * null we end up with NaN in the aggregated pipeline.

billing-bot: alert: pricing-refresh-job failed 2026-03-17T02:13Z (retry succeeded at 02:30Z).

sam: Repro steps I ran locally: call /usage/aggregate for org_8fa2 with start/end that include 2026-03-17 02:00-03:00 -> API returns a row with total_cost = NaN. CSV export shows "" (empty cell). UI converts that to $0.00 tile.

maria: root cause hypothesis: transient pricing refresh failure created null price rows. compaction job didn't defensively coalesce null -> 0, so NaN propagated.

kim: Will check pricing-refresh retry window and whether there was any schema change causing nulls. Also searching for code paths that assume price != null.

alex: Customer impact: charts show $0 or blank which looks like free usage. This could be escalated. Recommend we 1) mark affected orgs as "suspect" in billing UI, 2) enqueue a re-run of compaction for those partitions, 3) patch pipeline to treat null price as fallback to last-known price or price_lookup_failure tag.

maria: I can trigger a backfill of compaction for the affected 02:00-03:00 window. Requesting list of all affected org ids (not just the two).

sam: I pulled recent support tickets — there are 9 orgs reporting same symptom. I'll send the list to ops.

sre-bot: deploy: metric_compaction v2.1.4 rolled out to batch workers at 03:45Z (no errors after patch).

kim: patch candidate: if price is null, write a placeholder field price_lookup_error=true and set cost=0 for aggregation, plus emit a metric so we can alert earlier. Will open PR.

customer-support: customer notified that we're investigating and we'll follow up when we have a regeneration ETA. Thanks team. :pray:

alex: Next steps: maria re-run backfill, kim opens PR with defensive handling + tests, sam send org list + customer comms draft, I'll coordinate any SLA follow-up. Please post updates here when done. :thumbsup:
